name: vol_surface_signal_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: The NIFTY option volatility surface (IV across strikes and expiries) contains predictive information for intraday index direction. Specifically, the put-call IV skew -- the difference between OTM put IV and OTM call IV at the same delta -- signals institutional hedging demand. When 25-delta put IV is >5 vol points above 25-delta call IV (steep skew), institutions are paying up for downside protection, suggesting elevated tail risk. Paradoxically, extremely steep skew (>8 vol points) tends to precede intraday rallies as the feared event doesn't materialize and the skew premium unwinds. The strategy fades extreme skew levels by buying NIFTY50 CE when put skew is extreme and buying PE when skew compresses to complacency.
indicators: skew = put_IV_25d - call_IV_25d  # in vol points
skew_rate_360 = (skew - skew[360]) / 360  # skew change per 5s bar over 30 min (360 bars)
term_structure = IV_next_week_ATM - IV_this_week_ATM  # term structure slope

conditions: NIFTY_RSI_360 < 40 (NIFTY has pulled back, confirming fear)
term_structure > 0 (contango -- not a crisis term structure)
long.confirmation: skew starts declining (skew_rate_360 < 0 for 60 consecutive 5s bars = 5 min) -- fear premium unwinding

conditions: skew_z < -1.5 (skew compressed -- complacency, calls bid up)
short.confirmation: skew starts rising (skew_rate_360 > 0 for 60 consecutive 5s bars = 5 min) -- complacency reversing

entry.entry_price: market order on NIFTY50 ATM CE/PE at skew reversal confirmation

exit.target: skew_z normalizes to 0.5 (long) or -0.5 (short); OR option premium moves 0.5% in trade direction
exit.stop_loss: skew_z exceeds 3.5 (long) suggesting genuine crisis OR option premium drops 0.5% from entry
exit.trailing_stop: after 0.3% gain on premium, trail at 0.15% below best premium
exit.time_stop: exit after 12 bars (60 seconds) if no progress
exit.signal_exit: if ATM_IV spikes > 3 vol points in 360 bars (30 min) while in BUY_CE position, exit (genuine risk event)

risk.position_sizing: skew-adjusted: base_size * (1 - 0.05 * (skew - 5)) -- smaller when skew is extreme

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX between 14 and 25 (need options to be liquid for accurate IV)
filters.time_filter: enter 09:20-14:00; skew signals need session time to play out
filters.volume_filter: NIFTY option volume at 25-delta strikes > 1000 contracts (ensuring IV is reliable)
filters.trend_filter: NIFTY not limit-down or in circuit-breaker mode
filters.event_filter: skip on F&O expiry day (skew is mechanically distorted by rollover); skip budget, RBI
other_filters: option IV data must be real-time (not delayed >5 sec); stale IV creates false skew signals

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate -- as more traders access real-time option analytics, the skew signal may weaken

mechanism: At 5-second frequency, the vol surface signal benefits from detecting skew micro-reversals with precision. The skew (put_IV - call_IV) updates as option chain snapshots refresh every few seconds. At 5s resolution, we detect the moment when a previously steepening skew begins to flatten -- this inflection point is when the CE premium is about to rise (as put IV compresses, the overall fear premium unwinds, lifting the index). Entering at the 5s-detected skew reversal gives a 15-30 second head start over 1-min detection, which translates to meaningful premium capture on ATM options where delta is ~0.5 and gamma is highest.
adaptation_notes: Adapted from 1-min equity/ETF strategy to 5-sec index option strategy. Key changes: (1) Universe changed from NIFTYBEES/top-5 stocks to NIFTY50 index options (BUY_CE/BUY_PE), (2) RSI lookback adjusted from 30 bars to 360 bars (equivalent 30 min at 5s), (3) Skew rate changed from 30-bar to 360-bar window (same 30-min window at 5s), (4) Skew confirmation changed from 5 consecutive 1-min bars to 60 consecutive 5s bars (same 5 min), (5) Hold time compressed from 60-240 minutes to 5-60 seconds -- scalping the initial premium adjustment as skew normalizes, (6) Entry/exit now reference option premium (BUY_CE/BUY_PE) instead of equity BUY/SHORT on NIFTYBEES, (7) IV staleness tolerance tightened from 5 min to 5 seconds given 5s bar frequency.
weaknesses: Requires real-time option chain data with accurate IV computation; stale option quotes can make the skew signal misleading at 5s frequency
Extremely low frequency: skew_z > 2.0 signals fire only 2-4 times per month, making this a supplementary strategy only
When the skew is extreme for a genuine reason (geopolitical crisis, systemic risk), fading it produces large losses -- the event filter cannot catch all such scenarios
prior_art: Bali & Hovakimian (2009) option implied volatility and equity returns; Xing et al. (2010) on skew and stock returns. Indian vol surface analysis by Jain & Jain (2019).
notes: Adapted for 5-second NIFTY50 index option trading. Edge math: 0.62 * 50bps - 0.38 * 35bps = 31 - 13.3 = 17.7bps gross. This is a high-conviction, low-frequency strategy best combined with others.
